tools.name: search_ingredients
tools.description: Search CleanIngredients ingredient names, summaries and species notes. Includes core and later-stage research; returns status, source links and review dates. Empty query lists ingredients.

tools.name: get_ingredient
tools.description: Get a botanical ingredient's grades, species, buying considerations and published source reviews. Use the slug from search_ingredients. Includes actual offering counts; does not imply availability.

tools.name: search_supplier_research
tools.description: Search company-published botanical supplier research. Every result is an unconfirmed research lead with a source URL and outstanding evidence checks. No stock, price, sample or quote availability is implied.

tools.name: get_evidence_coverage
tools.description: Read current coverage counts for the core ingredients, including confirmed offerings and source reviews. These are directory counts, not market-wide statistics.

tools.name: calculate_landed_cost
tools.description: Estimate total and per-kg cost from buyer-provided inputs. All amounts must be in one currency. Duty is a total monetary amount, not a percentage. No live freight, duty or supplier quotes are fetched.

tools.name: calculate_active_cost
tools.description: Compare assay-based ingredient costs. Price is per kg; assay is percent (0 < assay <= 100); targetActiveMg is desired active mass per serving. This is formulation arithmetic, not dosage advice.

tools.name: build_sourcing_brief
tools.description: Generate an RFQ draft for a catalog ingredient. Returns text only: does not store personal data, submit an inquiry, contact a supplier or place an order. Review the draft before using the website inquiry form.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "build_sourcing_brief" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Generate an RFQ draft for a catalog ingredient. Returns text only: does not store personal data, submit an inquiry, contact a supplier or place an order. Review…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_ingredients, get_ingredient, search_supplier_research, get_evidence_coverage · Private data: build_sourcing_brief · Public sink: build_sourcing_brief.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_ingredients, get_ingredient, search_supplier_research, get_evidence_coverage · Private data: build_sourcing_brief · Public sink: build_sourcing_brief

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
